blocks.x: Blockchain & Digital Trust inside Retail & Consumer Goods: what the sector's controls demand, what we build on the platform rails, and the outcomes written into the engagement.

In Retail & Consumer Goods, blockchain & digital trust delivers distributed-ledger programs where a shared, verifiable record has economic value: enterprise dlt networks for multi-party workflows, asset tokenization, smart contract engineering and audit, provenance and traceability, decentralized identity with verifiable credentials, and on-chain analytics for compliance. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: enterprise dlt network engineering, asset tokenization & digital assets, smart contract engineering & audit — delivered on Dataq Ledger and Dataq Sentinel with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Provenance claims unverifiable
Organic, recycled-content and origin claims face greenwashing scrutiny; evidence lives in supplier PDFs.
Demand signals too slow
Batch demand models react to last week; promotions, weather and local events shift baskets daily. Markdown decisions and replenishment both inherit the lag.
Personalization without privacy architecture
Personalization programs stall between marketing ambition and privacy office veto; consent, preference and profiling rules are retrofitted after launch.

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: PCI DSS 4.0 and EUDR (where applicable). Deforestation due diligence for relevant commodities. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

Delivery runs on one weekly rhythm for every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
